PublicRemarks: Waterfront living in Paradise Island, Awendaw, with expansive Wando River and tidal-marsh views, colorful sunsets and night skies. Set on a fenced, irrigated 0.76-acre cul-de-sac lot, this beautifully maintained elevated 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers an open chef's kitchen, fireplace, covered porches and a main-level primary suite. Upstairs are three bedrooms plus a vaulted music/media room with marsh views. The vented, dehumidified two-car garage level includes flexible workshop space and an elevator shaft for future installation. Whole-house dehumidification, a generator transfer panel and ADT security equipment add comfort and convenience. Enjoy a naturalistic Lowcountry setting plus a community dock, boat ramp and boat/RV storage, subject to association rules, fees and availability. The chef's kitchen features an oversized island, farmhouse sink and gas range, complemented by wide-plank hardwood floors and shiplap accents. The main-level primary suite includes a soaking tub, dual vanity and glass-enclosed shower. An upstairs bedroom currently serves as an office, and the garage workshop offers space for tools and water-sport gear. The whole-house dehumidifier is integrated with the HVAC system. Additional features include quality window treatments. ADT equipment conveys; buyers activate monitoring separately. Between the Wando River and Francis Marion National Forest, Paradise Island offers convenient access to Mount Pleasant, Costco, Seewee Outpost, Awendaw Green and SC Surf soccer fields. Schedule a private showing to experience the views and versatile spaces firsthand.

Welcome Home to 23 East Paige Wynd - Where Everyday Life Feels a Little More Special Some homes impress you with a list of features. Others make you picture your life there before you ever finish the tour. This is a custom-built RGTec home in Morrison Manor where thoughtful craftsmanship, generous spaces, and peaceful views come together to create a home designed for real life. From the moment you step inside, the difference is easy to feel. Inlaid flooring, detailed trim work, recessed lighting, and ceiling fans throughout give the home a polished, custom feel without sacrificing warmth or comfort. The kitchen is truly the heart of the home. A center island gives everyone a place to gather, whether it is breakfast before school, homework in the afternoon, or friends lingering while dinner is being prepared. Warm under-cabinet lighting adds just the right glow in the evenings, while the oversized pantry with sensor lighting keeps everything organized and close at hand. And when everyone comes through the door at once, the dedicated drop zone gives bags, shoes, backpacks, and everyday clutter a place of their own. One of the best things about this home is how easily it adapts to every season of life. Need a quiet place to work from home? There is a dedicated office on the main floor. Need somewhere for everyone to spread out? Head upstairs to the massive bonus room, where movie nights, game days, sleepovers, and family gatherings can all happen in one space. With surround sound, room for the pool table, a full bath, and a bar area, it feels like having your own private hangout right at home. The wider 36-inch doors throughout also add to the open, comfortable feel, making everyday life just a little easier. And while the home is beautiful, some of its most valuable features are the ones you may not immediately see. Spider insulation, a radiant barrier, conditioned crawlspace, and Anderson windows were all chosen with comfort and efficiency in mind. The current owners have enjoyed an average electric bill of less than $200, giving you an idea of how thoughtfully this home was built. Then there is the view. The home sits beside the neighborhood walking path and community pond, creating a peaceful backdrop that can be enjoyed from the bedrooms and living spaces throughout the house. Imagine waking up to the pond outside your window, enjoying your first cup of coffee while everything is still quiet, or ending the day with a walk around the neighborhood as the sun goes down. It is the kind of setting that encourages you to slow down and enjoy being home. The outdoor spaces were designed for everyday living too. The porch includes its own drain for easy cleanup, a rain barrel adds a practical touch to the landscaping, and thoughtful systems throughout the property help make maintaining the home simpler. Inside, little extras like central vacuum, a heated bathroom fan for chilly mornings, and a security system add another layer of comfort and convenience. At 23 East Paige Wynd, the custom details are impressive, but it is the lifestyle they create that really makes this home stand out. There is room to gather, room to work, room to play, and room to simply enjoy the view. If your next chapter looks like more space, peaceful surroundings, and a home where everyone has a place to settle in and feel comfortable, 23 East Paige Wynd may be exactly what you have been looking for. Welcome home to Morrison Manor.

With plenty of open lawn surrounded by a natural wooded backdrop, the backyard offers room to spread out, entertain, garden, or simply enjoy the additional space. Completing the property is a front-load two-car garage with a generator hookup, adding everyday practicality to an already versatile home.
